messages.subject: Reactivity in Shiny
parts:
Dear all,

I'm building a Shiny app where the user can choose a csv file. In a certain part of the code, there is a sequence of variables that need to be reactive to the user inputs (clicks on the plots).

I'm using 'reactive' function on each variable created, something like:

A <- reactive({
    if (is.null(mydata())) {
      return ()
    }
    mydata <- mydata()
    A <- mydata$X1 - mydata$X2
  })

B <- reactive({
    if (is.null(mydata())) {
      return ()
    }
    mydata <- mydata()
    B <- mydata$Y1 - mydata$Y2
  })
.
.
.

But, since there are many variables, I'd like to know if there is another way to use 'reactive' function (or another one) only once for all of those variables.

Another question, is it possible to make Shiny read the data file and attribute global variables to those data? 


Thanks in advance
